name: POST /api/auth/sso/exchange - trade the one-time SSO code for a session
description: Public: the code (from the /sso/complete URL fragment, valid 2 minutes, single use) is the credential. Returns the same session shape as login (token, refreshToken, user, org, role) for the user's primary firm. Covers: a user can sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO.

errorCases.when: unknown, expired or already used code
code missing or shorter than 20 characters

errorCases.message: not an active member of any firm
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Needs a real identity-provider round trip for an account with no active membership (no member-removal API until F10.2).

happyPathNote: The success case needs a code minted by a real provider round trip; verified with a local OIDC mock (exchange 200, reuse 401).
